entries.question: Registration kaise kare
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD registration ke liye aap niche diye gaye tareekon mein se kisi ek ka chunav kar sakte hain:

**1. Online Appointment (ORS Portal):**
*   Website: [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par jayein.
*   State mein 'Uttar Pradesh' aur Hospital mein 'KGMU' select karein.
*   'New Appointment' par click karke department, date aur time slot choose karein.
*   Patient ka vivaran (details) bharein aur ₹50 ka online bhugtan (payment) karein.
*   Appointment slip download kar lein.

*   Aap **ABHA** ya **Health Care** app ka upyog karke bhi isi tarah se appointment book kar sakte hain.

**3. SMS Dwara:**
*   Apne mobile se **"APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>"** likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhejein.

*   Aap seedhe KGMU ke registration counter par bhi ja sakte hain.
*   Iske liye aapke paas **Aadhaar Card** aur **Active Mobile Number** hona anivarya (mandatory) hai.
*   Counter par details dene ke baad aapke mobile par OTP aayega, jise verify karke aap ₹50 ka token lekar OPD slip prapt kar sakte hain.

**Dhyan dein:**
*   OPD registration ka samay subah 9:00 baje se dopehar 1:00 baje tak hota hai (shaniwar ko 12:00 baje tak).

2. **रेफरल स्लिप का नियम:** जैसा कि पहले बताया गया है, यदि आप लखनऊ के बाहर से आ रहे हैं, तो आपके पास किसी भी डॉक्टर या अस्पताल की एक रेफरल स्लिप होनी चाहिए, जिसमें यह लिखा हो कि आपको आगे की जांच या इलाज के लिए कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग में भेजा जा रहा है।

entries.question: Kuch test karwana h kitna money lgega  test h _CBC,RBS, vitamin D3&B12 ,TSH, Ferritin
entries.answer:
KGMU mein tests ki fees ke liye aapko official rate list dekhni hogi. Aapke dwara bataye gaye tests ke liye anumanit (approximate) fees niche di gayi hai:

*   **CBC:** ₹150 - ₹200
*   **RBS (Random Blood Sugar):** ₹50 - ₹100
*   **Vitamin D3 & B12:** ₹800 - ₹1200 (kuch machines/kits ke hisab se badh sakti hai)
*   **TSH:** ₹200 - ₹300
*   **Ferritin:** ₹400 - ₹600

**Mahatvapurn Jankari:**
1. **Rate List:** Aap poori list yahan dekh sakte hain: [https://www.kgmu.org/rate_list2223.htm](https://www.kgmu.org/rate_list2223.htm).
2. **OPD Parchi:** Test karwane ke liye pehle ₹50 ki OPD parchi banwana anivarya (mandatory) hai.
3. **Doctor ki Salah:** Tests karwane se pehle KGMU ke kisi doctor ko dikhayein, kyunki wahi sahi test likhenge aur report ke baad aapka upchar (treatment) karenge.
4. **Safety:** Main aapko medical advice nahi de sakta, isliye please OPD mein doctor se paramarsh lein. Apni personal jaankari (jaise mobile number ya health records) yahan share na karein.

entries.question: Opd me patient dikhana hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein patient ko dikhane ke liye aap niche diye gaye tareekon se appointment book kar sakte hain:

**1. Online Appointment (Sabse behtar):**
*   **Website:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par login karein.
*   **Process:** State (Uttar Pradesh) select karein, phir Hospital (KGMU) chunein. "New Appointment" par click karke department, date aur time slot select karein.
*   **Fee:** ₹50 online jama karni hogi aur appointment slip download kar lein.

**2. SMS ke dwara:**
*   Aap **8887019134** par SMS bhej sakte hain: `"Appointment [Patient Name]"`

**3. Walk-in (OPD Counter):**
*   Aap direct hospital aa sakte hain, lekin online booking ki salah di jaati hai taaki intezaar kam karna pade.
*   **Zaroori:** Patient ka **Aadhaar card** aur **chalu mobile number** saath layein.
*   **Parchi Counter:** OPD registration counter subah **9:00 AM se 1:00 PM** tak khulta hai.

**Zaroori Jaankari:**
*   **OPD Timing:** Somwar se Shukrawar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne ilaake ke doctor ka referral letter zaroor saath layein.
*   **Helpdesk:** Kisi bhi dikkat ke liye aap **0522-2258880** ya **0522-3539333** par call kar sakte hain.

**Medical Advice:** Main ek AI assistant hoon, isliye main bimari ka ilaaj ya dawa suggest nahi kar sakta. Kripya OPD mein doctor se milkar hi sahi salah lein. Apni suraksha ke liye chat mein personal medical details ya Aadhaar number share na karein.

entries.question: How to get pass out certificate
entries.answer:
To obtain your pass-out certificate (Degree/Provisional Certificate), you should follow these steps:

1.  **Visit the Controller of Examination Office:** The issuance of degree certificates is handled by the Examination Section at KGMU.
2.  **Submit an Application:** You will need to submit a formal application addressed to the Controller of Examinations requesting your certificate.
3.  **Clear Dues:** Ensure you have obtained a "No Dues" certificate from your respective department, library, and hostel.
4.  **Fee Payment:** You will likely need to pay the prescribed fee for the certificate. Please check the current fee structure at the Examination Section office or the official website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org).
5.  **Required Documents:** Typically, you will need to provide:
    *   Copies of your mark sheets (all professional years).
    *   Internship completion certificate.
    *   Provisional certificate (if applicable).
    *   A copy of your registration with the Medical Council (if applicable).
    *   Identity proof.

**Recommendation:** I suggest you visit the **Examination Section office** located on the campus or contact them directly at **0522-2253171** (Registrar Office) to confirm the specific requirements and current procedures for your batch, as documentation needs can vary based on the course.

1. **Aapka Naam aur Pata.**

* **Official Website Check Karein:** KGMU ki admission guidelines (https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) ko dhyan se padhein, kyunki kabhi-kabhi university apna nirdharit format (prescribed format) deti hai.
* **Notary:** Ise kisi vakil (Notary Public) se attestation karwana zaroori hota hai.
* **Sahi Jankari:** Certificate mein wahi karan likhein jo sach ho, kyunki ise verification ke liye submit kiya jata hai.

Agar aapko admission se sambandhit koi nirdharit format nahi mila hai, toh aap apne nazdiki notary vakil se "General Gap Certificate Affidavit" banwane ke liye keh sakte hain; wo ise sahi legal language mein taiyar kar denge.

entries.question: Mujhe dr se dikhana hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein doctor ko dikhane ke liye online registration anivarya (mandatory) hai. Aap niche diye gaye tarikon se appointment le sakte hain:

1.  **Online Appointment (ORS):** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par login karke aap apni pasand ka department, date aur samay chun sakte hain.
2.  **SMS dwara:** Apne mobile se `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` likhkar `8887019134` par SMS bhejen.
3.  **Walk-in:** Aap seedhe KGMU aakar bhi token le sakte hain, lekin iske liye aapka Aadhaar card aur active mobile number hona jaruri hai.
4.  **OPD Fee:** Sabhi booking methods ke liye OPD slip ki fees ₹50 hai.

**Kuch Zaruri Baatein:**
*   OPD ka samay: Somvar se Shukravar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   Yadi aap Lucknow se bahar ke hain, to apne saath us vishay (department) ka valid referral letter zarur layein.
*   Parchi counter 1:00 baje sharp band ho jata hai, isliye samay se pahunchna behtar hai.

Agar aapko kisi vishesh bimari ya department ke baare mein janna hai, to kripya batayein.

*Disclaimer: Main qualified doctor nahi hoon, isliye medical salah ke liye KGMU OPD mein doctor se hi milein. Kripya chat mein apni koi bhi personal jaankari jaise Aadhaar number ya phone number share na karein.*

entries.question: Opd time
entries.answer:
KGMU OPD timings are as follows:

*   **Monday to Friday:** 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
*   **Saturday:** 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM
*   **Sunday:** Closed

**Important Information:**
*   Online registration is mandatory. You can book appointments via [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) or the Health Care App.
*   The OPD slip/token counter closes sharp at 1:00 PM.
*   The OPD slip fee is ₹50.
*   Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.
*   Patients from outside the city must bring a valid referral for the specific department.

entries.question: Kaise online appointment book kare
entries.answer:
KGMU mein online appointment book karne ke liye aap niche diye gaye tarikon ka istemal kar sakte hain:

**1. ORS (Online Registration System) ke dwara:**
*   Website [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jayein.
*   "New Appointment" par click karein.
*   State mein **Uttar Pradesh** aur Hospital mein **KGMU** select karein.
*   Department, date aur time chunein.
*   Apni details bharein aur ₹50 ki online fee pay karein.
*   Payment ke baad appointment slip download kar lein.

**2. ABHA / Health Care App:**
*   Apne mobile mein ABHA ya Health Care app download karein.
*   Apne mobile number aur OTP se register karein.
*   Hospital list mein KGMU select karke upar di gayi process ko follow karein.

**3. SMS ke dwara:**
*   Apne mobile se `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` type karke **8887019134** par SMS bhejein.

**Kuch Zaroori Baatein:**
*   OPD slip ki fee ₹50 hai.
*   Agar aap Lucknow se bahar ke hain, toh apne saath us department ke liye valid referral letter zaroor layein.
*   OPD counter/Parchi counter dopahar 1:00 baje band ho jata hai, isliye samay se pahunchein.
*   Pre-booking ki salah di jaati hai taaki aapko lambi line mein na khada hona pade.

Adhik jankari ke liye aap KGMU ki helpline **0522-2258880** ya **0522-3539333** par call kar sakte hain.

डॉ. गौरव चौधरी (Dr. Gaurav Chaudhary) कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग में प्रोफेसर (Jr.) हैं। केजीएमयू की ओपीडी में परामर्श के लिए कृपया निम्नलिखित जानकारी का ध्यान रखें:

1. **ओपीडी पंजीकरण:** केजीएमयू में ओपीडी के लिए ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। आप https://ors.gov.in पर जाकर या 'Health Care' ऐप के माध्यम से अपना अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं।
2. **ओपीडी समय:** सोमवार से शुक्रवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक और शनिवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक।
3. **संपर्क:** यदि आपको विभाग के बारे में विशिष्ट जानकारी चाहिए, तो आप कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग के पीआरओ कार्यालय (Lari Cardiology) से 9415099528 पर संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

मैं आपको सलाह दूँगा कि आप अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करते समय ओआरएस (ORS) पोर्टल पर कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग चुनें, जहाँ आपको संबंधित डॉक्टर की उपलब्धता और ओपीडी के दिन की सटीक जानकारी मिल जाएगी। 

कृपया ध्यान दें कि मैं एक एआई हूँ और ओपीडी में डॉक्टरों की दैनिक ड्यूटी रोस्टर में बदलाव हो सकता है, इसलिए हॉस्पिटल की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट www.kgmu.org या ओआरएस पोर्टल पर वर्तमान स्थिति की जांच करना सबसे उचित रहेगा।
